# Wardogs: Explosion, Impact, Prop and Muzzle Flash Fields

*Source: the data assets under `Content/VFX/Explosions`, `Content/VFX/Weapons/Impacts`, `Content/VFX/Weapons/MuzzleFlashes` and `Content/Environment/Blueprints/VehiclePropTooling`. The tables are generated by [`_tools/fx_data_tables.py`](https://github.com/Kiyogitpy/wardogs-data-docs/blob/main/_tools/fx_data_tables.py) and checked with `--check`. Evidence: [round 89 env](https://github.com/Kiyogitpy/wardogs-data-docs/blob/main/docs/evidence/round89-env.md).*

This page lists every field the assets store, so it repeats some columns of [VFX](Wardogs_VFX_v2.md) (the shorter explosion and impact tables) and [Muzzle Flashes](Wardogs_MuzzleFlashes_v1.md) (the flash tables with notes on how the layers fit). A blank cell means the asset leaves the field unset and the class default applies; the export does not give that default. The units of sizes, distances and amounts are not stated in the export. Misspellings such as `Multiplyer` and `CaliberSIze` are the game's own names.

<!-- fx_data_tables counts -->
| Asset class | Assets | Section |
|---|---:|---|
| `PDA_Explosion_C` | 35 | 1 |
| `PDA_PhysicalMaterialResponse_C` | 9 | 2 |
| `PDA_VehicleProp_C` | 34 | 3 |
| `PDA_MuzzleFlash_C` | 48 | 4 |
| `PDA_MuzzleFlashAttachement_C` | 47 | 4 |
<!-- /fx_data_tables -->

## 1. Explosions (`PDA_Explosion_C`)

One recipe per explosion. The first table holds the fireball, core and heat values, the second the particles, shockwave and camera shake. The 14 timing sequences that chain these recipes are on the [VFX page](Wardogs_VFX_v2.md#3-explosion-sequences-pda_explosiontimingdata_c-14-assets).

## 2. Impacts per physical material (`PDA_PhysicalMaterialResponse_C`)

The three caliber columns are the size of the impact effect for small, medium and large bullets. The explosion effects list holds one Niagara system per explosion size (small, medium, big) when the asset gives three. Body and head have blood effects and no decals.

## 3. Vehicle props (`PDA_VehicleProp_C`)

Each asset assembles a scenery vehicle from meshes: a base body, glass, cabin, load, roof and wheels, with a colour set per part. When an asset lists several colours, one is chosen for each placed prop (the choice rule is not in the export). These are world props, not drivable vehicles.

## 4. Muzzle flashes

A weapon recipe (`PDA_MuzzleFlash_C`) names its default muzzle device in the last column, and the device asset (`PDA_MuzzleFlashAttachement_C`) holds multipliers. Recipe names follow the weapon, for example `DA_MuzzleFlash_AK74-M` uses `DA_MF_AK74-M_Default`. The export does not store which shop muzzle device uses which device asset; see [Muzzle Flashes](Wardogs_MuzzleFlashes_v1.md). Colours are red / green / blue as stored; the values go above 1 because they are HDR emissive colours, and the `Hex` field the export prints next to them does not match them, so it is left out.
